source.name: LUDB
source.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
source.enrollment: Every publisher RECORDS row; retain missing or invalid signals as technical failures, never omit based on labels, scores or routes.
source.reference_authority: Publisher ECG diagnoses and explicitly enumerated principal rhythm, not adjudication of underlying disease. The released set is a selected mix of volunteers and patients.
source.subject_key: One source record per subject per publisher README, no cross-dataset person linkage.
source.overlap: Compare same-format exact waveform fingerprints and document actual prior inventory coverage. Do not promote to historically independent if prior manifests or reliable subject links are incomplete.

route.margin: min across P8/P4 of min absolute class score minus original class threshold distance, then subtract that profile cutoff
route.accept: Both profiles scored and both signed margins >= 0. Emit original P8/P4 sets, including original P8 fallback.
route.abstain: Both profiles scored and any signed margin < 0. Emit neither set; retain baseline calls only for counterfactual audit.
route.technical_unscored: Either routed profile could not score. Do not count as abstention or clinical referral.
route.refer: Not implemented for published system. No second-stage or human outcomes. Any new composite is a separately named study.

reference_rules.principal_negative: Only another recognized, mutually exclusive principal rhythm; unknown or conflicting categories stay unknown. NSR denotes source-recorded sinus rhythm, not a normal ECG or a disease-free subject.

positive_only.RBBB: explicit complete RBBB; incomplete not equivalent
positive_only.LBBB: explicit complete LBBB; incomplete not equivalent
positive_only.2AVB: explicit second-degree AV block, not duration or conduction proxies
positive_only.3AVB: explicit third-degree or complete AV block
positive_only.PAC: explicit atrial extrasystole or PAC; do not infer from irregular sinus rhythm
positive_only.PVC: explicit ventricular extrasystole or PVC, at ECG level
positive_only.Paced: explicit ECG pacing; device status alone does not prove paced rhythm
positive_only.LVH: explicit left ventricular hypertrophy; overload alone does not qualify

reference_rules.positive_only_negative: Only an explicitly documented endpoint-compatible negative; generic silence, another finding and sinus rhythm do not count.
prohibited_equivalences: unspecified ischemia/scar = a named infarct territory
reference_rules.unknowns: Remain in all ECG/route denominators; excluded from endpoint binary comparisons and never imputed.

analysis.primary_estimand: Per original profile membership predictions on every eligible ECG for endpoints with explicitly known references; top-1 retained as a distinct secondary quantity.
analysis.matched_contrast: Nested restricted subset: at least one known positive mapped primary label for the profile; same scores and endpoint definitions; common estimable endpoints shown separately.
analysis.selective: One joint decision per ECG, unconditional flow plus positive disposition. Risk is error over known ECG-endpoint opportunities; report opportunity counts and per-class counts, with missingness caveat. AURC is computed from the frozen signed margin ordering with ties grouped and references never used for route construction.

uncertainty.cluster: connected components of source subject and exact waveform

analysis.underpowered: Retain all descriptive confusion and support; mark <5 independent clusters in either polarity sparse, and suppress unsupported two-sided estimates when a polarity is absent. Do not change endpoints after observing performance.
analysis.reporting: Distinguish emitted false negatives, abstained positives with no output, and baseline false negatives counterfactually found among abstentions. No performance acceptance threshold.
